summary: Examples assert a URL matches a regex, including a case-insensitive version.
questions: How do I assert a URL matches a pattern?
How do I use ignorecase in a regex test?

answer_card.title: regex test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- assert:
    that:
      - 'url is regex("example\.com/\w+/foo")'
  vars:
    url: "https://example.com/users/foo/resources/bar"
- assert:
    that:
      - 'url is regex("EXAMPLE\.COM/\w+/foo", ignorecase=True)'
```
